The nbfx Wizard API defines the JavaFX wizard SPI — Wizard and WizardPanel — the @WizardRegistration annotation, the discovery contract WizardEntry/WizardRegistry, and the WizardDisplayer seam the shell implements.
A module implements Wizard/WizardPanel and declares it with @WizardRegistration. The module's generated layer supplies the id, display name, icon, category and position; WizardRegistry reads those entries through LayerPaths.WIZARDS. The themed WizardDialog in platform.wizard is the T0 implementation that shows the pages.
A downstream module implements a wizard with API imports only; the shell discovers it through WizardRegistry and shows it in the wizard dialog.
The registry is unit-tested with layer entries, and the processor test asserts the generated layer fragment for a sample annotated source. The API is under development until the MVP freeze, after which API signature tests (sigtest) are enabled.
A JDK is required to compile the annotation processor.
Only org.netbeans.api.nbfx.wizard is public. The processor implementation is an implementation detail and is not exported.
The processor is discovered by the compiler through the META-INF/services/javax.annotation.processing.Processor service, generated by @ServiceProvider(service=Processor.class).
